items.claim: editing a by-axis seed stores its JSON text as a string seed
items.note: the Seeds layer now shows the seed's value at the current selection and writes only that branch.

items.claim: editing a by-axis pin in Pins or Components overwrites every branch with one flat value
items.note: this is the same mistake as the seed finding, fixed by the same new `writeAt`/`leafAt` helpers in `theme/model.ts`.

items.claim: Inspect misses tokens a component reads through its own private custom properties
items.note: it now follows each custom property that a real declaration reads (`--btn-radius` → `--wzl-button-radius`, and accent remaps), and one that nothing reads still adds nothing.

items.claim: "Compare in preview" shows two identical previews when a ramp's pins are all inherited
items.note: the button now uses the same own-pins test as "Adopt generated".

items.claim: PinRepair labels a bezier or other array pin "varies by axis" and offers no field
items.note: array pins now edit as text through `serializeTokenValue`/`parseTokenValue`. "varies by axis" is shown only for a pin that does, and any other uneditable pin reads "not editable here".

items.claim: changing the Ramp of a rule whose step varies by axis drops the variation
items.note: every branch's step is kept when the new ramp has it, and only a step the new ramp lacks moves to its first step. The same now holds for a plain step, which used to reset even when the new ramp had the same step.

items.claim: the palette lab's stat verdicts use fixed thresholds, not the gates set
items.note: a new `gateVerdict` in `palette/unmetGates.ts` decides both the stat colors and the infeasible line, and a gate set to 0 shows no verdict.

items.claim: "Copy as tokens" writes duplicate keys when an anchor shares a name with a generated swatch
items.note: the cause was in `@weasel-js/theme`'s `generate`, outside this area. It named generated swatches by hue without regard to the anchors' names, so I fixed it there. Anchor names are claimed first, and any repeat becomes `name-2`, including two anchors that share a name. That case is my own call, not one anyone has ruled on. It comes with a changeset (`palette-swatch-names-distinct.md`, patch, fix) and an updated property test in `generate.pbt.test.ts`.

items.claim: the New theme dialog reopens with the last name and its error
items.note: opening it now clears both.

items.claim: Scales layer crashes the app when the draft does not derive
items.note: The table now falls back to the last draft that derived. To make that possible, `DerivedDraft` now records the definition it was derived from.

items.claim: "Compare in preview" throws during render once the draft stops deriving
items.note: There is no generated variant while the draft fails to derive.

items.claim: The semantic drawer's literal field turns a number or array into a string
items.note: The field now shows the value the way CSS writes it (`cubic-bezier(…)`) and parses it back to the type it came in as. The pins layer (`TokenLayer`) made the same mistake: a `type: 'number'` pin edited from `0.5` to `0.6` was saved as `'0.6'`. Both now go through one helper, `tokenValueFromText` in `theme/model.ts`.

items.claim: Turning "Varies by" off and on leaves the drawer editing a branch the rule no longer has
items.note: If the chosen branch is not among the rule's values, the drawer picks one of its branches again.

items.claim: The swatch panel decides "pinned" by an anchor name that the sources and the hex pin share
items.note: A swatch now counts as pinned when an anchor has its color (hue, lightness and chroma), and clicking it unpins that anchor.

items.claim: The gates editor shows a gate that varies by axis, or is a reference, as a default number, and moving its slider overwrites it
items.note: Such a gate is now shown as written, with no slider. The "unmet gates" explanation is skipped while any gate is held this way, because the constraints the app has are not the ones the deriver ran.

items.claim: A reload while the draft does not derive drops the whole undo history
items.note: A saved history that passes through the state the editor reopens on is restored and stepped back to that state, with the later steps left to redo. A history that never passes through that state is still dropped.

items.claim: The palette lab's saved history sits under its live state's key prefix, so every save of the state also reads and parses the history, up to a megabyte
items.note: The history moved to `weasel.theme-editor.palette-history`, and a history saved under the old key is moved over on load. The reviewer's suggested `live-history` would not have worked: the prefix match is a plain string match, so it still starts with `…live`.

items.claim: Undo on the theme prefs page puts back every leaf
items.note: Each undo step now records, and puts back, only the leaves it changed.

items.claim: Saving a preset under a built-in's name does nothing and says nothing
items.note: Save is disabled for that name, and a status line says the name belongs to a built-in preset.

items.claim: ThemeEditor crashes when the theme list comes back empty
items.note: It now shows a "No themes to edit" message with a Name field and Create. The same crash happened when discarding the last unsaved theme, and this covers it too.

items.claim: Inspect reports tokens from `@media` / `@supports` rules that do not apply
items.note: Those rules are now skipped when the page does not meet them. A condition the environment cannot test still counts.
